title: Women's Land Army: Feeding a Nation
hook: City girls took over heavy farm plows to save Britain.

scenes.text: With hundreds of thousands of male farm workers drafted into the military, British agriculture faced total collapse.

scenes.voicedText: With hundreds of thousands of male farm workers drafted into the military, British agriculture faced total collapse.

scenes.text: Eighty thousand women volunteered for the Women's Land Army, swapping office desks and shop counters for heavy rubber gumboots.

scenes.voicedText: Eighty thousand women volunteered for the Women's Land Army, swapping office desks and shop counters for heavy rubber gumboots.

scenes.text: They worked fifty-hour weeks milking stubborn cows before dawn, catching destructive rats, and digging drainage ditches in freezing rain.

scenes.voicedText: They worked fifty-hour weeks milking stubborn cows before dawn, catching destructive rats, and digging drainage ditches in freezing rain.

scenes.text: City women who had never touched machinery learned to steer heavy iron Fordson tractors across rocky hillsides.

scenes.text: Thanks to the 'Land Girls', Britain doubled its domestic food output, ensuring the country never starved during blockade years.
